title: TESTING THE CRUISE SHIPS CRAZY NEW WATER SLIDES !
description:
So  today we finally had some time to test out Liberty of the seas new water slides! I haven't seen a tube water slide like this on any of the ships I have been on before so it was definitely something different and a lot scarier than I thought. If you look at my  face going down on the snapchat play back it was all cheery at first haha and THEN.....
